name: Cost per stop
note: Vendor benchmark for standard parcel delivery, printed as '$8-$12 for standard parcel delivery; $10-$20 for specialty (grocery, medical)'. Typ left empty: the source gives a range only. Not a bench for bulky or pallet stops.
source_name: Upper Route Planner, Last-Mile Delivery Benchmarks

name: Stops per driver-hour
note: Printed: '2–4 stops per hour for on-demand local delivery and 4–8 for dense, preplanned routes.' Low=on-demand floor, high=dense preplanned ceiling.

name: Revenue per truck-day
note: No published benchmark found for small carriers that is printed at a stable URL; leave empty and use parameters.csv rate_* rows to bound it.

name: On-time %
note: Upper: '95% or higher is the industry standard; 96% or higher signals top-tier performance.' Shipday: '95% or higher; investigate anything below 90%.' Low=90 (Shipday investigate line), typ=95, high=96.

name: Cube utilization %
formula: sum(ft3_loaded) / vehicle_cube_ft3 * 100 (per dispatch, at max load point)
note: No published benchmark found; leave empty.

name: Weight utilization %
formula: sum(lb_loaded) / vehicle_payload_lb * 100 (per dispatch, at max load point)
note: No published benchmark found; leave empty.

name: Empty (deadhead) mile %
note: ATRI Operational Costs of Trucking: 'Empty miles increased to an average of 16.7%' (2024 data, 2025 report, via Cottingham & Butler) and 'Deadhead mileage... rose to an average of 16.3 percent for all non-tank operations' (2023 data, June 2024 update, via FreightWaves). Low=16.3 is the earlier year, not a fleet range. The 2026 report (2025 data) summaries checked do not print an empty-mile figure.
source_name: ATRI via Cottingham & Butler | ATRI via FreightWaves

name: Rate per mile, all-in
note: Derived from DAT August 2026 national averages, linehaul plus that month's average fuel surcharge: van spot 2.19+0.70=2.89 (low); van contract 2.41+0.70=3.11 (typ); flatbed spot 2.70+0.84=3.54 (high). Reefer spot 2.61+0.77=3.38. Assumes DAT's contract figure is also linehaul (ex-fuel). Reference cost: ATRI 2025 average cost $2.336 per mile (all miles), TL $2.21, LTL $2.58 (ttnews).
source_name: DAT Freight & Analytics news release (Aug 2026 rates)

name: Operating ratio
note: Low=75.2: Old Dominion FY2025 operating ratio (8-K ex 99.1, 'Operating ratio 76.7% 75.9% 75.2% 73.4%', Q4 25/Q4 24/FY25/FY24). Typ=88.4: derived 100-11.6 from ATRI 2025 LTL average operating margin 11.6% (ttnews). High=99.6: derived 100-0.4 from ATRI 2025 truckload margin 0.4% (ttnews); flatbed margin was -0.5% (OR 100.5). Other public LTL FY2025: Saia 89.1% (adjusted 89.6%), ArcBest Asset-Based 93.7%. Public-carrier ORs are best-in-class for LTL; small fleets sit near the ATRI sector figures.
source_name: Old Dominion 8-K | ATRI via Transport Topics | Saia 8-K | ArcBest 10-K

name: Detention collected %
note: No published benchmark found; leave empty.

name: First-attempt delivery %
note: Upper: '85-93% industry average; top-performing fleets hit 95-98%.' Shipday: '95% or higher for local delivery; 98% or higher for attended appointments.' Low=85 (Upper avg floor), high=98 (both sources' ceiling). Typ empty: the two vendors disagree on average (Upper 85-93 vs Shipday 95 target).

name: Driver overtime hours
formula: sum over drivers of max(0, on_duty_hours - ot_threshold_hours)
note: No published benchmark; the threshold and multiplier come from parameters.csv (overtime_multiplier). Leave bench empty.

name: Cost per hundredweight
note: Derived as revenue per cwt x operating ratio (cost = revenue x OR). Low: Old Dominion FY2025 LTL revenue per hundredweight $33.31 x OR 0.752 = $25.05. High: ArcBest Asset-Based FY2025 billed revenue per hundredweight incl. fuel $49.02 x OR 0.937 = $45.93. Typ left empty (only two carriers). These are national network carriers, a ceiling on efficiency for a small P&D shop.
